purpose: Bounded pre-merge validation for the first 150 auto-confirmed price rows before mutating the v42 workbook/core dataset.
merge_rules_locked: Join by exact mhlw_plan_code at plan level.
Do not substitute a related-treatment price for another plan.
Do not treat ancillary fees as treatment prices.
Preserve multiple valid price options for the same plan as separate price rows.
Preserve tax and unit labels as captured; do not infer missing tax treatment.
Keep audit-only plans outside the v42 core and retain them only in the audit trail.
next_step: Apply these 150 validated price rows to the v42 staging structure, save a checkpoint, then validate the next bounded batch.
